_doc: The aim-train range far above the surf course. Lengths in metres, positions in the range frame: origin at 'center', turned range_yaw about y (x right, y up, z toward the spawn; lanes run toward -z). Distances are measured from the firing line. Bot size is movement.json hull_height (72 u), so 'parts' and 'props' positions are fractions of that height in the bot's own frame (x to its left as you face it, z toward the player). A part is a hittable body in a hitgroup; a prop is a mesh riding on a part (when: always, face = outfits whose 'face' is true, otherwise the outfit's head or chest gear: wrap / can / hood / mask, plate / rig). A sphere's 'b', when b.y is not zero, scales its mesh per axis (0 = 1; the hitbox stays the sphere of radius r). An 'rbox' is a box hitbox drawn as a rounded pill of the same size. Time to kill runs from the shot that first hit that bot to its death (a one-tap is 0 ms); the kill interval runs from the later of the bot standing up (or the round starting) and your previous kill, and a second kill by the same shot adds no interval.
